title: QA Automation Engineer - Fresher
text:
Responsibilities
- Write and maintain automated UI tests with Selenium
- Design manual test cases for new features and log defects
- Test REST APIs with Postman and automated scripts
- Work in two-week Agile sprints

Eligibility
- B.E./B.Tech 2025 or 2026 graduates
- Programming in Java or Python
- SQL basics to verify data
- Familiarity with Git

Nice to have
- CI/CD experience (running tests in a pipeline)
